column1: # mapping_set_title: Semantic mappings of facility and event types in contextual indicators to Wikidata

# mapping_set_description: Manually curated mappings from facility, environmental-feature, and event-type concepts used in contextual indicators to Wikidata entities used in proposed FHIR RDF representations.

column17: Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept; vegetation). The source dataset refers specifically to the total area of large inland surface-water bodies, whereas the mapped Wikidata concept is broader and includes all inland waters and watercourses, including groundwater.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept; vegetation). Dataset-specific green space including verges, grass areas, trees, and parks; narrower than the general concept of vegetation.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). In the source dataset, residential area includes both residential areas and leisure accommodation. The mapped Wikidata concept is narrower and refers specifically to self-contained accommodation used as a home, such as a house, apartment, mobile home, or houseboat.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). The source dataset defines commercial land use as retail and catering establishments. The mapped Wikidata concept is broader because it also includes other commercial services.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). The source dataset category refers specifically to social and cultural services, whereas the mapped Wikidata concept more broadly represents areas characterised by relatively homogeneous human activities.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). The source dataset combines offices and public services. The mapped Wikidata concept corresponds only to the public-service component.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). The source dataset combines green and recreational spaces, including parks, forests, graveyards, sports fields, and day-recreation areas. The mapped Wikidata concept covers recreation areas only, resulting in partial semantic overlap.
Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept).

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept; public transport). Used as the facility type for public transportation density; all values of stopplace_type are included in the SPARQL aggregation.

column9: All bus-related stop types were grouped as bus stops
column17: Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept; bus stop). Source value of stopplace_type; classified as a bus stop for calculating the number of bus stops.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept; railway station). Used as the facility type for calculating the distance to the nearest train station; relevant railway-station values of stopplace_type are selected in SPARQL.

Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept). The source dataset combines All trees, shrubs, and low vegetation, while Wikidata concepts covers green area planned in an urban location.
Proposed facilityType extension to FHIR Observation (CodeableConcept).
